MERIDIAN GRID CORPORATION — CURRENT REPORT
Filed June 2, 2026

On May 29, 2026, the audit committee concluded that a material impair-
ment charge is required with respect to the company's western intercon-
nect transmission assets.

The company estimates a pre-tax non-cash charge of between $310 million
and $340 million, to be recorded in the second quarter of fiscal 2026. The
company does not expect the charge to result in future cash expendi-
tures.

The impairment follows the state utility commission's May 21 order deny-
ing recovery of approximately $270 million in deferred capital costs. The
company intends to seek rehearing, and no assurance can be given that
such rehearing will be granted.

Management reaffirmed full-year adjusted earnings guidance of $3.05 to
$3.20 per share, which excludes the impairment charge. Management also
noted that the company's debt covenants are calculated on an adjus-
ted basis and are not expected to be affected.

Separately, the company disclosed that its chief financial officer will de-
part effective July 31, 2026, and that a search for a successor is under-
way. The company stated that the departure is unrelated to the impair-
ment or to any disagreement on accounting matters.
